policy.selection: largest D26 first; clean ellipsebit=0; single-galaxy groups only; every JPEG HEAD verified
policy.identifier: own exact PGC, otherwise own exact NGC/IC; no sky-proximity join
policy.uniqueness: one catalogue object and photograph per SGA_ID
policy.image: published observation image-grz.jpg only; no model, residual, montage or diagram
